taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-05 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1320.7 | 0.60 | 0.60
2 | 719.2 | 0.46 | 1.06
3 | 872.7 | 0.61 | 1.67
4 | 340.7 | 0.38 | 2.05
5 | 4088.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HKH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-05
Curve type: HKH
Aquifer depth: 1.67–2.05 m
Recommendation: The target aquifer corresponds to the low-resistivity layer (340.7 ohm-m) sandwiched between two higher-resistivity units; given its limited thickness (~0.38 m), the drilling team should core carefully through this interval and verify water saturation with downhole logging before setting screens, as yield may be limited by the thin saturated zone.
